name: Mireia Flores
original_name: ミレイア・フローレス
source:
She is the princess of the Kingdom of Flores, which is blessed with agricultural and mineral resources.

She has a ladylike personality, as is typical of a country with a rich natural environment, from the plains to the mountains. She is a neat girl with excellent manners and grace, and is called the “princess among princesses” for her compassionate heart.

Her benevolent appearance and royal bearing are reminiscent of her own mother, the queen, and she has a strong following among the public.

She has a glamorous figure, especially with her ample breasts, which attract the eyes of others. Some call her the “Blessed Mountain of Flores” or not.

She is engaged to the love of her life (Aries' brother, Wolff, the second prince of Brattenhardt), to whom she has promised her future.

[From [url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/sanbiki.html#character]official site[/url]]
